Package frc.robot.networking

Class NetworkedTelemetry.SystemsCheck

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.networking.NetworkedTelemetry.SystemsCheck
Enclosing class:
NetworkedTelemetry
public static class NetworkedTelemetry.SystemsCheck extends Object
Systems-check telemetry — owns all NetworkTables result entries for the automated test-mode sequence. Command-building logic lives in frc.robot.SystemsCheck; this class only handles NT reads/writes so that the networking layer stays free of subsystem dependencies.

  • Method Details

    • resetResults

      public static void resetResults(boolean hood, boolean turret, boolean flywheel, boolean intake, boolean indexer, boolean climber, boolean swerve)
      Resets result entries to false only for enabled systems, leaving results for skipped systems unchanged. Also sets overall to "RUNNING".
      Parameters:
      hood - whether the hood check is enabled this run
      turret - whether the turret check is enabled this run
      flywheel - whether the flywheel check is enabled this run
      intake - whether the intake check is enabled this run
      indexer - whether the indexer check is enabled this run
      climber - whether the climber check is enabled this run
      swerve - whether the swerve check is enabled this run

    • computeOverall

      public static boolean computeOverall(boolean hood, boolean turret, boolean flywheel, boolean intake, boolean indexer, boolean climber, boolean swerve)
      Evaluates result entries only for enabled systems and sets Overall to "PASSED" or "FAILED".

      Systems that were not checked in this run are excluded from the evaluation entirely — a skipped system never causes a failure.

      Returns:
      true if every checked entry passed
